questions.prompt: What is the capital city of United States?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the United States article.

questions.proof: The capital city is Washington, D.C. and the largest city by population is New York, in the State of New York, with a population of 8.8 million people.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with United States?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture United States on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the United States article.

questions.proof: Forty-eight of the states are connected (Contiguous United States), and they are bordered by Canada to the north and Mexico to the south.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of United States?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Language” part of the United States article.

questions.proof: Both Hawaiian and English are official languages in Hawaii by state law.

questions.prompt: What money is used in United States?

hints.nudge: Money names often come from a country’s own words. The other three are spent in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Money” part of the United States article.

questions.proof: The currency of the land is the United States dollar ($).

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The state of Alaska is in the northwestern area of the continent near Asia (_____) and is separated from the other 48 states by Canada making it an exclave.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “Asia”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the United States article.

questions.proof: The state of Alaska is in the northwestern area of the continent near Asia (Russia) and is separated from the other 48 states by Canada making it an exclave.
